vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: remotion-word-highlight-subtitles
Version: 0.1.2

The skill provides a legitimate workflow for adding word-level highlighted subtitles to videos using Whisper and Remotion. It includes a Python script (scripts/whisper_json_to_captions.py) for processing transcription data and detailed instructions in SKILL.md for the AI agent to manage the video processing pipeline. No indicators of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection were found.

llm.summary: This appears to be a local video-subtitle workflow; it runs local media/rendering tools and writes generated files, but the provided artifacts do not show hidden credential use, data exfiltration, persistence, or deceptive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe transcribing a user-supplied local video, converting Whisper word timestamps into caption JSON, and rendering highlighted subtitles with Remotion. The bundled Python script only reads a Whisper JSON file and writes a captions JSON file.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The workflow asks the agent to run local tools such as ffprobe, ffmpeg, Whisper, Python, and Remotion, and to create or reuse a Remotion project. This is broad command use, but it is disclosed and directly aligned with local video rendering.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec; the skill depends on already-installed local binaries and Remotion project dependencies. Users should verify their local ffmpeg, Whisper, Node/npm, and Remotion setup.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill processes local video/audio and generated transcript/caption files, and writes output next to the source video by default. No upload, credential use, or unrelated data access is shown.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifacts do not show background services, autostart, privilege escalation, credential storage, or persistent agent memory. Generated media/project files may remain on disk as part of the normal workflow.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, make sure you trust your local ffmpeg, Whisper, Node/npm, and Remotion setup. Run it only on videos you intend to process, choose output paths carefully to avoid overwriting generated files, and remember that transcript, caption JSON, copied video, and rendered output files may remain in the working directory.

evidence.explanation: The skill explicitly directs the agent to execute local media-processing and rendering commands. This is expected for the stated purpose, but users should understand it will run local tools and create files.
evidence.snippet: Inspect the source with `ffprobe` ... Run Whisper word timestamp transcription ... Convert the Whisper JSON ... Build or reuse a small Remotion project ... Render with Remotion

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use the skill only with videos and directories you intend to process, and make sure the local tools it relies on are trusted and installed from reputable sources.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The agent may use CPU, disk space, and local command-line tools to process the selected video and produce generated files.

evidence.explanation: The rendering workflow depends on external local project dependencies that are not bundled or pinned in the provided artifacts. This is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but it means the local toolchain affects safety.
evidence.snippet: Remotion dependencies in the generated or reused Remotion project

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Review or create the Remotion project in a trusted workspace and avoid running npm/Node dependencies from unknown sources without checking them.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: If the local Remotion/Node environment is untrusted or misconfigured, the rendering step could inherit those risks.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill uses purpose-aligned local command execution and external rendering dependencies, with no hidden automatic execution or destructive behavior shown.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, account privileges, tokens, or delegated authority are requested or shown.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: No persistent memory, cross-agent sharing, remote upload, or credential/session data handling is shown in the provided artifacts.
